##### Project general facts

California Residences by Infracorp is a thoughtfully designed residential development within the established California Village community in Dubai, offering a refined balance of contemporary architecture and warm, family-oriented living. The project features an elegant façade and a low-density, landscaped setting that enhances privacy while maintaining a strong sense of community. Its architectural language combines modern simplicity with natural tones, creating a calm and sophisticated residential environment.

The lifestyle at California Residences is enriched by a wide range of amenities designed to support wellness, recreation, and social connection. Residents can enjoy a resort-style swimming pool, fully equipped gym, yoga deck, and meditation zones, alongside active leisure facilities such as padel courts and an outdoor cinema. Landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, cafés, and community lounges further enhance the experience, creating a well-rounded environment where every generation can relax, connect, and thrive.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials that emphasize comfort, light, and functionality. Spacious layouts with open-plan living areas are complemented by fully equipped kitchens and carefully selected finishes that create a clean, contemporary aesthetic. Each residence is designed to offer a peaceful and practical living experience, where simplicity and quality come together in perfect harmony.

##### Location description and benefits

Wadi Al Safa 4 is a rapidly developing residential area in Dubai, known for its serene environment and strategic location. This area is becoming increasingly popular among families and investors seeking a tranquil yet accessible place to live.

Situated in the heart of Dubai, Wadi Al Safa 4 offers easy access to major highways such as Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road, ensuring convenient connectivity to key parts of the city. This makes commuting to business hubs like Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai Marina both quick and straightforward.

Wadi Al Safa 4 is also home to a number of educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and retail centers, ensuring that all essential services are within close reach. The area's proximity to popular shopping destinations and entertainment venues further enhances its appeal, offering residents a balanced lifestyle with plenty of leisure options.
